offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per 1,000 calls (base rate, no volume/annual discount applied)
offerings.free_quota: Free — 100 queries/day, no api key required; $100 free credit
offerings.output_type: structured JSON web + news results with snippets, rich metadata (publication date, thumbnail, favicon); extraction modes: snippets (default), contents.highlights, contents.markdown/contents.html (full page)
offerings.note: Web and news in one query; up to 100 results/call; news + licensed knowledge results at no extra cost; country/language/freshness/domain filters; full page extraction billed separately at $1.00/1k pages fetched live; machine payments in USDC possible without account; ZDR/SOC 2 available.

offerings.name: Web Search API — Full page extraction add-on
offerings.pricing: Full page extraction add-on—$1.00 per 1,000 pages fetched live (billed separately from base Web Search API rate)
offerings.price_basis: per 1,000 pages, live-crawled only; extraction_source: cache adds no extraction charge
offerings.note: Only pages crawled live are billed; blend (default) charges only for uncached pages, fetch crawls all, cache is free. Example: count=10 + full_page = $0.023 total with 2/20 cached.

offerings.name: Contents API
offerings.output_type: clean Markdown or raw HTML per page, batch multiple URLs per request
offerings.note: Extract page text, summaries, metadata from multiple URLs; accessible via Search API livecrawl parameter; Python SDK, MCP Server, REST API.

offerings.name: Answer API
offerings.output_type: synthesized, citation-grounded answer generated only from retrieved passages; same operators as Web Search
offerings.note: Single-call web search + synthesis endpoint; POST https://api.you.com/v1/answer; 93.48% accuracy on SimpleQA.

offerings.name: Research API
offerings.pricing: Tiers: Lite, Standard, Deep, Exhaustive, Frontier — $12.00 /1k calls (Fast retrieval for simple factual lookups shown)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per 1,000 calls; $12.00 shown for the Lite-style entry tier (page lists multiple tier names without per-tier prices)
offerings.output_type: source-backed answers with inline references; multi-step search and synthesis pipeline
offerings.note: All tiers include cited, source-backed answers with inline references, multi-step search + synthesis pipeline, AAAI Best Paper Award methodology; #1 in DeepSearchQA.

offerings.name: Finance Research API
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per 1,000 calls; $110.00 shown for the entry-listed finance tier
offerings.output_type: multi-source research and synthesis; cited answers with traceable [[n]] source references
offerings.note: Covers filings, macro data, markets, derived calculations; structured multi-source research beyond web search; avoids fiscal year, unit, period errors.

offerings.name: MCP Server
offerings.free_quota: Try search with no signup at https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free (exposes you-search and you-discover); Docs MCP server is free to use
offerings.output_type: model tool calling you-search / you-discover over You.com APIs
offerings.note: Connect at https://api.you.com/mcp; research and finance via /mcp/research and /mcp/finance or ?tools= on /mcp. Docs MCP at https://you.com/docs/_mcp/server (searchDocs, no API key).

offerings.name: Knowledge for Web Search (knowledge parameter)
offerings.price_basis: included in Web Search API call price; no separate per-1k rate given
offerings.output_type: licensed-data answers with provider attribution in results.knowledge
offerings.note: Live stock prices, crypto, weather, prediction markets. Set knowledge: "core" (POST only) to request; results omitted when none relevant; billed at no extra cost per docs.
